description: Current position in the league standings. Lookup from standings snapshot; not computed from int_legs__team_match. Lower rank (1 = first) is better.
Total points earned over the form window (3 per win, 1 per draw, 0 per loss). SUM(CASE result WHEN W THEN 3 WHEN D THEN 1 ELSE 0 END).
numerator: CASE result WHEN W THEN 3 WHEN D THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

description: Average goals scored per match over the form window. SUM(goals_for) / games_in_window.
Average goals conceded per match over the form window. SUM(goals_against) / games_in_window.
Average total shots attempted per match over the form window. SUM(shots_total) / games_in_window.
Share of shots that were on target. SUM(shots_on_goal) / SUM(shots_total). Null when shots_total = 0.
Share of shots taken from inside the penalty area. SUM(shots_inside_box) / SUM(shots_total). Null when shots_total = 0.
Goals per shot on target (conversion rate). SUM(goals_for) / SUM(shots_on_goal). Null when shots_on_goal = 0.
Average total passes attempted per match over the form window. SUM(passes_total) / games_in_window.
Share of passes successfully completed. SUM(passes_accurate) / SUM(passes_total). Null when passes_total = 0.
Average corner kicks won per match over the form window. SUM(corner_kicks) / games_in_window.
Average corner kicks conceded per match over the form window. SUM(opponent_corner_kicks) / games_in_window.
Share of opponent shots on target that were saved. SUM(goalkeeper_saves) / SUM(opponent_shots_on_goal). Null when opponent_shots_on_goal = 0.
Total WC qualifier matches played in the campaign. Raw count of finished legs in the qualifier window.
Points earned as a share of the maximum possible in the qualifier campaign. SUM(points) / (3 × games_in_window). Same point scale as points_won_form; denominator is 3 × match count.
numerator: CASE result WHEN W THEN 3 WHEN D THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

description: Average goals scored per qualifier match. Same formula as goals_per_match_recent applied to the qualifier window.
Average goals conceded per qualifier match.
Average total shots attempted per qualifier match.
Team's share of total shots across both sides in qualifier matches. SUM(shots_total) / (SUM(shots_total) + SUM(opponent_shots_total)). Null when combined shots = 0.
Share of qualifier shots taken from inside the penalty area.
Share of qualifier shots that were on target.
Goals per shot on target in qualifier matches.
Pass completion rate in qualifier matches.
Average passes attempted per qualifier match.
Average corner kicks won per qualifier match.
Average corner kicks conceded per qualifier match.
Save ratio in qualifier matches. SUM(goalkeeper_saves) / SUM(opponent_shots_on_goal).
Goals scored in the form window. SUM(goals_total) from int_legs__player_match.
Goal assists in the form window. SUM(goals_assists) from int_legs__player_match.
Shots on target in the form window. SUM(shots_on).
Successful dribbles in the form window. SUM(dribbles_success).
Dribble attempts in the form window. SUM(dribbles_attempts).
Dribble success rate. SUM(dribbles_success) / SUM(dribbles_attempts). Null when dribbles_attempts = 0.
Key passes in the form window. SUM(passes_key). API definition: a pass leading directly to a shot. Every assist is a key pass; not every key pass is an assist.

Accurate passes in the form window. Derived as SUM(passes_total × passes_accuracy_percent / 100). Inherits a small per-fixture rounding error (~±1–2 passes) because passes_accuracy_percent is stored as integer.
Total passes attempted in the form window. SUM(passes_total).
Pass completion rate. SUM(passes_accurate) / SUM(passes_total), where passes_accurate is the derived sum above. Null when passes_total = 0.
Duels won in the form window. SUM(duels_won). A duel is any 1v1 physical contest (ground and aerial pooled); tracked independently from tackles by the provider.
Total duels contested in the form window. SUM(duels_total).
Duel win rate. SUM(duels_won) / SUM(duels_total). Null when duels_total = 0.
Tackles made in the form window. SUM(tackles_total).
Interceptions in the form window. SUM(tackles_interceptions).
Shots blocked in the form window. SUM(tackles_blocks).
Goalkeeper save percentage. SUM(goals_saves) / (SUM(goals_saves) + SUM(goals_conceded)). Null when denominator = 0. Applicable only to goalkeepers; outfield players will have null goals_saves.
Yellow cards in the form window. SUM(cards_yellow).
Red cards in the form window. SUM(cards_red).
